Welcome to Polar International Transport
Polar International provide a Freight Transport and Logistics Service throughout Ireland, the UK and Europe. With over 47 years of delivering quality Supply Chain Management services, we offer a client specific service portfolio within the areas of Transportation, Refrigeration, Logistics & Storage. Our principles continue to originate from maintaining client trust and by delivering logistical solutions in the most innovative and cost effective ways. We achieve this by setting industry standards in service, reliability, safety, innovation & technology.
We provide specialist services for the following industries: Pharmaceuticals/Life Sciences, Air-Freight, Temperature Controlled Freight & FMCG, Hazardous Cargo(ADR), High Value Goods, fuel & lubricants. Our Multi Temperature Services include: Transport / Warehousing / Distribution.
Polar international views its clients as partners. Our philosophy is driven by our team of motivated staff throughout the company who consider client engagement of key importance. The result is that Polar International is a reliable and honorable partner for all your logistics activities. The proof of this can be found in the numerous long-term relationships we have built up with our current partners.

CUSTOMISED DELIVERIES & SPECIAL HANDLING
Polar International is a family run premium logistics provider that offers customised and integrated transportation and logistics solutions across Ireland, Uk and continental Europe.
Polar international Ltd provides comprehensive delivery services and warehouse logistics across the UK, Ireland and Europe. Our commitment to service means we can guarantee same day or overnight delivery from the warehouse direct to the customer. We ensure our clients cargo is safely and securely delivered on-time and in perfect condition to their complete satisfaction.
Our warehousing and distribution capabilities, proprietary packing methodology and our secure, state-of-the-art storage facilities provide the client with peace of mind that there goods will be handled with care and will arrive at their destination intact and on time.
Polar international Ltd offers its clients customised warehousing and delivery services to suit businesses of all sizes and requirements. From parcel delivery to contract logistics, to cross docking, Polar are able to provide customised solutions and facilities to meet each client’s needs.
We consider our clients - our partners. Polar’s philosophy is driven by our team of motivated staff throughout the company who consider client engagement of key importance. The result is that Polar is a reliable and honorable partner for all your logistics activities. The proof of this can be found in the numerous long-term relationships we have built up with our current partners.

CUSTOMISED DELIVERIES & SPECIAL HANDLING
Polar provides a range of specialist services to aid more particular and complex delivery requirements. Whether you need assistance with customs clearance or are in search of a custom bonded warehouse to store your dutiable goods.
We can provide the correct and approved documentation required for exports and ensure the successful storage and distribution of your goods across international borders.
Our skilled air, ocean and inland delivery task force are highly experienced at handling various forms of customised deliveries and are equipped to take on any challenge.
If you need delivery services that go beyond the norm, contact Polar. We can customise our delivery service to suit your exact requirements.
Our range of specialist services include:
We have an experienced and well-trained task force capable of handling the most unique delivery requirements
Polar are here to provide all the assistance you need with customs clearance and international exports
